           HOMARUS

         Digestive Fluid of Live Lobster


Dyspepsia, sore throat, and headache seems to be a combination that may
        be controlled by this remedy. Frontal and temporal pain chiefly, with soreness in eyes.
        Throat sore,   raw  , burns, with tough mucus. Pain in
        stomach and abdomen, better after eating. Belching. Chilliness and pain all over. Itching of
        skin.



Modalities.--    Worse  , from
        milk, after sleep.   Better  , from motion, after eating.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Sepia;
        Asterias; Astacus; Aethusa  .



Dose.--  Sixth potency.
